name: quandora
description: Quandora Factor Mining and Strategy workflows for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Use Quandora services from your agent.
interface.longDescription: Quandora packages Factor Mining and Strategy skills in one plugin. Agents can research and backtest factors, select eligible factors, compose cross-sectional strategies, retrieve verified artifacts, and summarize results.
defaultPrompt: Use Quandora Factor Mining to show public tasks.
Use Quandora Factor Mining with my custom factor idea.
Use Quandora Factor Mining to resume a run and summarize results.
Use Quandora Strategy to combine eligible factors into a cross-sectional strategy.
